what is the difference between prefill and decode?

Prefill processes the prompt tokens in batched matmuls to fill the KV cache; decode then runs one token at a time using the cached state. Prefill is bandwidth-bound on large prompts; decode is dominated by per-token attention scan plus MoE routing.
